programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan-0
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan-0
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Changbai Mountain
programme.desc: An unforgettable adventure awaits amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Changbai Mountain! Embark on a trek through pristine birch forests, marvel at the majestic power of the world's deepest volcanic waterfall, and uncover hidden gems along the way. Indulge in soaking in natural hot springs and experience exhilarating rafting down mountain streams, all leading to the final destination: Tianchi Lake, a heavenly oasis nestled in the clouds. Join the Travelogue team as we delve into the beauty of Changbai Mountain.

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life-0
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with...

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast....

programme.title: CGTN & UN Tourism ｜Exploring China’s New Tourism Frontier
programme.desc: This summer, inbound tourism in China continues to boom, with nearly 23 million inbound trips by foreign nationals recorded in the first half of this year. The growth has been supported in part by expanded visa-free access, more convenient transit policies and continued improvements in tourism services.At the same time, rural tourism is playing an increasingly important role in China’s rural revitalization strategy. Join us on BizTalk for insights from UN Tourism and China Agricultural University as we explore China’s rural tourism model, the strong recovery in inbound travel and the next phase of growth for the country’s tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China Episode 4
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the cutting edge of Chinese industry. We visit China’s first offshore spaceport to see rockets launch toward the stars and move to Hangzhou’s E-Fashion Town, where AI turns designs into reality in seconds. We also follow the "fantastic journey" of a bag of garbage as it transforms into energy and bricks with the help of industrial intelligence. Finally, we explore the "emotional economy," where young people find solace in trendy toys and historical fragrances.

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. In this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series...

programme.title: Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series...

programme.title: Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series...

programme.title: Policy push brings smart homes into everyday life
programme.desc: China has expanded and upgraded its dual-new policy package, marking the first-ever inclusion of smart home products in central government consumption subsidies. programme.title: CGTN & UN Tourism ｜Exploring China’s New Tourism Frontier
programme.desc: This summer, inbound tourism in China continues to boom, with nearly 23 million inbound trips by foreign nationals recorded in the first half of this year. The growth has been supported in part by expanded visa-free access, more convenient transit policies and continued improvements in tourism services.At the same time, rural tourism is playing an increasingly important role in China’s rural revitalization strategy. Join us on BizTalk for insights from UN Tourism and China Agricultural University as we explore China’s rural tourism model, the strong recovery in inbound travel and the next phase of growth for the country’s tourism industry.

Join us on BizTalk for insights from UN Tourism and China Agricultural University as we explore China’s rural tourism model, the strong recovery in inbound travel and the next phase of growth for the country’s tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China Episode 4
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the cutting edge of Chinese industry. We visit China’s first offshore spaceport to see rockets launch toward the stars and move to Hangzhou’s E-Fashion Town, where AI turns designs into reality in seconds. We also follow the "fantastic journey" of a bag of garbage as it transforms into energy and bricks with the help of industrial intelligence. Finally, we explore the "emotional economy," where young people find solace in trendy toys and historical fragrances.

programme.title: Why China's theme parks are having a moment
programme.desc: Looking for a cool summer escape with a twist? China’s theme parks are more than rides—they’re immersive worlds of blockbuster stories, spectacular shows, high-tech thrills, and local flavors.Earlier this year, CGTN's Lincoln Humphries and Yu Hongyu explored two of China's best-known parks to see why they’re drawing crowds from across the country. From unforgettable live performances to next-level interactive experiences, discover a fresh way to travel in China.

programme.title: Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. In this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series...

programme.title: The Martini Shot
programme.desc: This existential comedy follows an ailing movie director as he shoots what he believes to be his final work of art. What starts out as a normal movie, ends up being an exploration of mortality and one's profound effect on the world.

programme.desc: A young man finds solace with a young woman, his mother, and a high-school football coach who recruits him to quarterback a six-man team.

programme.desc: When mill worker Lydia is abandoned by her philandering husband, she struggles to look after herself and her son Charlie. Local doctor Jean is one of the few to help and a friendship develops that blossoms into a romance that will scandalise the town.

programme.title: It Snows All The Time
programme.desc: Paul did everything a person is supposed to do to keep their mind healthy - until he gets Dementia. As his disease progresses, his family comes together to decide what to do.

programme.title: The Seven Faces of Jane
programme.desc: Jane sheds her mundane life and experiences romance, comedy, tragedy and existential crises on a surreal road trip as imagined by eight different directors who had no knowledge of each other's segment.

programme.title: Please Stand By
programme.desc: A young autistic woman runs away from her caregiver to boldly go and deliver her 500-page Star Trek script to a writing competition in Hollywood. On an adventure full of laughter and tears, Wendy follows the guiding spirit of Mr. Spock on her journey into the unknown.

programme.desc: In an imagined chapter from his 40 days of fasting in the desert, Jesus tangles with Satan for the souls of a family in crisis.

programme.title: Rex

programme.title: Between The Lights

programme.title: From Time to Time

programme.desc: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, while Scorpius tries to avoid discovery. Zhaan makes a personal sacrifice.

programme.title: Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.sub-title: S3:E3 Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.desc: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.sub-title: S3:E4 Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew escapes the other ship and wormhole. Things are complicated when their new 'friends' sabotage Moya.

programme.title: Different Destinations
programme.desc: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool back in time where they alter the timeline.

programme.title: Eat Me
programme.desc: Crichton lands his transport pod on a dying leviathan full of cannibals and a scientist who can create clones.

programme.title: Thanks For Sharing
programme.desc: Moya rendezvous with Talyn who is seriously hurt. D'Argo and Rygel try to find Clorium, a drug to help Talyn.

programme.title: Green Eyed Monster
programme.desc: Talyn is swallowed by a boodong, leaving Stark and Rygel stranded in a transport pod.

programme.title: Losing Time
programme.desc: Moya's crew starts blacking out and missing portions of time. Pilot becomes inhabited by another entity.

programme.title: Relativity
programme.desc: Talyn lands on a planet covered with healing plants. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship to find Xhalax.

programme.title: Incubator
programme.desc: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: Talyn wants to fly into a sun. While near it Stark is contacted by an alien woman being held against her will.

programme.title: Scratch N Sniff
programme.desc: Pilot forces Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana to take a holiday as he is fed up with their bickering.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.sub-title: S3:E14 Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.desc: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.sub-title: S3:E15 Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.desc: Jack unlocks Crichton's wormhole knowledge so they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

programme.title: Revenging Angel
programme.desc: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world.

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aeryn leaves to grieve on a planet. She spots someone who might be her father but not all reunions are happy.

programme.title: Fractures
programme.desc: Escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have returned from Talyn.

programme.title: I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.sub-title: S3:E20 Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research. They must board the command carrier and destroy it from within.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.sub-title: S3:E21 Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

programme.title: Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground. D'Argo destroys a Leviathan that attacks other ships.

programme.title: Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.sub-title: S4:E2 What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.sub-title: S4:E3 What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks. They must stop the magnetic storm on Arnesk.

programme.title: Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.sub-title: S4:E4 Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: The crew is enroute to meet with Moya. They eat Noranti's concoction and raiders entomb Rygel in amber.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Everyone reunites on Moya. Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims he saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

programme.title: Natural Election
programme.desc: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programme.title: John Quixote
programme.desc: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

programme.title: I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.sub-title: S4:E8 I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.desc: When Moya is raided by Peacekeeper bounty hunters, everyone is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.

programme.title: A Prefect Murder
programme.desc: While Moya's crew are resupplying on a xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect.

programme.title: Coup By Clam
programme.desc: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. But if not ingested by the same person, it becomes deadly.

programme.title: Unrealized Reality
programme.desc: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.

programme.title: Kansas
programme.desc: Crichton accidentally alters the past, causing his dad to fly on the doomed shuttle 'Challenger'.

programme.title: Terra Firma
programme.desc: Crichton has arrived home. Although the crew relaxes, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.

programme.title: Twice Shy
programme.desc: Moya takes on a new passenger, but she is an alien in disguise, intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.

programme.title: Mental As Anything
programme.desc: The crew's males undergo training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes, D'Argo learns self control.

programme.title: Bringing Home The Beacon
programme.desc: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon that will allow Moya to camouflage.

programme.title: A Constellation Of Doubt
programme.desc: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a tv documentary.

programme.title: Prayer
programme.desc: Crichton and Scorpius travel to one of the 'unrealized realities'. Aeryn resists torture on a Scarran ship.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programme.sub-title: S4:E19 We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programme.desc: The crew goes after Aeryn on a Scarran controlled station.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.sub-title: S4:E20 We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.desc: Moya arrives at Katratzi. Crichton attends peace talks between Scarrans and Peacekeepers with a nuclear bomb.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.sub-title: S4:E21 We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.desc: Scorpius has betrayed the crew. Now they're all captured. The plan failed so the crew must help Scorpius.

programme.title: Bad Timing
programme.desc: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans travel through a wormhole to Earth, where those flowers grow.

programme.title: Premiere
programme.desc: Astronaut John Crichton is sucked through a wormhole into a distant part of the universe.

programme.title: Exodus From Genesis
programme.desc: A locator beacon on Moya is automatically broadcasting its exact location to Peacekeeper forces in the area.

programme.title: Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.sub-title: S1:E3 Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.desc: The crew rescues a scientist and his assistant from a disintegrating ship.

programme.title: Throne For A Loss
programme.desc: Rygel is captured by bounty hunters. He stole a crystal from Moya and she will crash if it isn't returned.

programme.title: PK Tech Girl
programme.desc: The crew finds the Zelbinion battleship. They work to get the shield functional before it's attacked again.

programme.title: Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.sub-title: S1:E6 Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.desc: The crew visits a planet of happy workers. Rygel's fluids become explosive. Aeryn and Pilot must learn why.

programme.title: I, E.T.
programme.desc: A peacekeeper beacon goes off and Moya has to land on an alien planet to prevent its signal being intercepted and Moya being discovered.

programme.title: That Old Black Magic
programme.desc: Crichton and Crais's spirits are captured by Maldis, who thrives on hate. Zhaan takes a dark path to fight.

programme.title: DNA Mad Scientist
programme.desc: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew and promises to use it to find their home planets.

programme.title: They've Got A Secret
programme.desc: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute and gets ejected into open space.

programme.title: Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.sub-title: S1:E11 Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.desc: John and Aeryn avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole while flying his ship near a high flare sun.

programme.title: The Flax
programme.desc: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.

programme.title: Rhapsody In Blue
programme.desc: Z'han joins her own people, but one of them wants something from her and will do almost anything to take it.

programme.title: Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

programme.title: Durka Returns
programme.desc: Moya collides with a Nebari ship. Durka is on board and has been mind cleansed. He now serves the Nebari.

programme.title: A Human Reaction
programme.desc: Moya travels through an unstable wormhole that appears to lead to Earth.

programme.title: Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Moya tries to starburst to prove herself but it goes wrong when she gets split into several dimensions.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: A peacekeeper ship approaches Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base.

programme.title: The Hidden Memory
programme.desc: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind. Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.

programme.title: Bone To Be Wild
programme.desc: The crew find a planetoid that's a paradise occupied by a scientist and a girl. But one is a killer.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: Moya's crew say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before trying to save Moya and her baby.

programme.title: Mind The Baby
programme.desc: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them.

programme.title: Vitas Mortis
programme.desc: D'Argo does a sacred ritual to help an old Luxan survive. He draws energy from Moya making her age rapidly.

programme.title: Taking The Stone
programme.desc: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by thrill seekers who play life threatening games.

programme.title: Crackers Don't Matter
programme.desc: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya and everyone starts acting paranoid.

programme.title: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Chiana finds a recording with Moya's prior Pilot. Pilot orders Aeryn to leave after realizing she was there.

programme.title: Picture If You Will
programme.desc: Chiana buys a picture which is more than it seems. The picture shows Chiana what will happen to her.

programme.title: Home On The Remains
programme.desc: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn can tolerate the spores.

programme.title: K1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E46 K1 World Grand Prix: Final 14, Osaka, 2003
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final Elimination was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Osaka Dome in Osaka, Japan on Saturday, October 11, 2003 in front of 31,700 spectators. It was the final elimination competition for the K-1 World Grand Prix 2003, involving fourteen fighters from across the world, with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs). The fourteen fighters were a mixture of invitees or had qualified via previous events.

programme.title: K1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E47 K1 World Grand Prix: Finals, Tokyo, 2003
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan on Saturday, December 6, 2003 in front of 67,320 spectators. It was the eleventh K-1 World Grand Prix final involving ten of the world's best fighters (two being reservists). The eight finalists had almost all qualified via preliminary events, while two additional fighters were invited as reserve fighters (for more detail on this see bulleted list below), with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs).

programme.desc: GLORY 98 features the highly anticipated return of Jamal Ben Saddik (36-9, 29 KO) against the Estonian powerhouse Uku Jürjendal (20-9, 16 KO). In the co-main event of the evening, GLORY Welterweight World Champion Chico Kwasi (43-5-1, 23 KO) is set to defend his title against number two ranked welterweight Teodor Hristov (18-3, 7 KO). Meanwhile, two of 2024’s best prospects will clash as Cem Caceres (18-1, 14 KO) faces Mory Kromah (31-2-1, 18 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.sub-title: S00 : E04 GLORY Light Heavyweight Grand Prix 2024
programme.desc: The eight-man one-night GLORY Light Heavyweight Grand Prix will crown the baddest light heavyweight striker on the planet. The eight participants are: GLORY champion, #C Tarik Khbabez (58-10-1, 28 KO), Morocco. Former champion, #1 Donegi Abena (27-10, 7 KO), Suriname. Former champion, #2 Sergej Maslobojev (38-6, 23 KO), Lithuania. Undefeated in GLORY, #3 Stefan Latescu (17-2, 8 KO), Romania. ‘Mister Cool’ #4 Ibrahim El Bouni (41-9-1, 22 KO), Morocco. The wild & unpredictable, #5 Bahram Rajabzadeh (67-2, 59 KO), Azerbaijan. Top French light heavyweight, #6 Pascal Toure (20-6, 7 KO), France. Veteran fighter, #7 Bogdan Stoica (58-14, 40 KO), Romania.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Classics with a Twist
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Last things are first for this 'Upside Down' themed One Big Recipe featuring Montreal chef Kimberly Lallouz. Fruit and cheese to start? Why not? Check out her dessert wine poached Grilled Pears and Blue Cheese Salad. Next, Beef Tartare Sliders are spiked with horseradish aioli and served on warm brioche. Pasta follows, but in keeping with her topsy turvy theme, Korean flavour meets Italian savour in her Kimchi Pappardelle. Fish is next, Loup de Mer en Papillote with Ã‰crasé Potatoes is dressed up with shaved fennel and rich beurre rouge sauce. How do you end an inside-outside- upside-downside dinner? With the perfect starter! Check out Kim's Oyster Shooters with Champagne Granité for a perfect final note...

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What on earth and/or sea is super fun host Kim Lallouz cooking this week for her One Big Recipe? You guessed it - Surf and Turf! First on the beach are her Singapore-inspired Chili Crab Cakes, redolent with southeast Asian aromatics and spices like lemongrass, ginger, and galangal. 'Turf's up' next with a fresh off-the-hoof Marrow Toast plate decked out with melty marrow, crispy crostini, and garlicky parsley salad. We all deserve a creamy cheesy break (right?), so of course Risotto Carbonara with Crispy Pancetta and Enoki Mushrooms follows. Braised Veal Osso Bucco is the big deal main course, all shored up surfingly with scrumptious Seared Scallops and smoky Grilled Broccoli Rabe!

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Well-traveled chef Kimberly Lallouz has familial ties to India, Morocco, and Spain, with culinary adventures from the Far East to the Deep South. Her 'Spiced Up!' One Big Recipe tries to tell a few chapters of that flavourful story on the plate. Starting on the milder side of the spice cabinet, Herbes de Provence inspires her Mediterranean Tomato Tart with Basil CrÃ¨me Fraiche. Next, South American spice meets northern ingredients in Arctic Char Ceviche with Rhubarb Vinaigrette. The centerpiece of her spice-studded supper is a Silk Road surprise, Cous-Cous Royale with Cornish Game Hens, Merguez Sausage and seasonal veggies. To finish, check out sweet, tangy, and pungent Blueberry Mostarda, served with creamy Burrata and Grainy Seed Loaf.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Protein-packed plant-based foods are on the One Big Recipe for chef Kimberly Lallouz's Vegetarian Dinner, five fun, filling courses designed for both vegetarians and omnivores. First up is yummy White Bean Hummus, served with pita, topped with savoury Caramelized Onion Jam and fried sage. Next is umami-packed Grilled Treviso Salad with arugula pesto, red grapes, and pine nuts. Brussels Sprouts shine in her Kimchi-inspired Korean take, topped with crunchy brown butter cashews. Salt Crusted Potato with Chive Oil will wow even the most skeptical carnivore in your orbit, and to finish, Pasta Giardina is a painting on a plate, tossing together multi-hued ribbons of garden veggies with fresh peas, mint, and a crumble of satisfying ricotta salata cheese.

programme.desc: Vanessa plans a springtime menu with a table to match! There's fava beans and asparagus salad, lamb shoulder with artichokes and mint, sumac-lime green beans, deviled eggs, and so much more!

programme.title: Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa and Stefania plan an afternoon tea with a table to match! There’s tea sandwiches, scones with jam and clotted cream, mini quiche, Steffy’s banana cake, and so much more!

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Every cook needs to learn their Mother Sauces before they can claim the title of Chef. Spice Secrets co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim are no different, though their sauce recipes sure are! First, a traditional Tomato Sauce re-examined as a Bucatini All'Amatriciana spiced with Quatre Épices! Next, a rich veal Demi-Glace spiced two different ways, served with veal chops and Roasted Mushrooms! Finally, a spin on a classic Béarnaise Sauce, replacing tarragon with Aniseed.

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 The Root of all Spices
programme.desc: Co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud get to the "root" of spicing up your food as they cook dishes using spice roots! First up, they prepare a creamy Carrot and Galangal Soup, however they don't use cream, opting for cashews instead! Next up, a frosty, golden Turmeric Semifreddo, studded with jewel-like apricots and pistachios! Last but not least is a steaming bowl of mussels, spiced with not one, not two, but three kinds of ginger! How can you not 'root' for these dishes?

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Spices were meant to be used in tandem, and our co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud will show you how! Cook along as they make a creamy, golden, Risotto Milanese, spiced not just with saffron, but with Ras el Hanout: a spice blend like no other! Next, a master class in spice blends and infusing them into oils, all topped off with some skewers of plump, juicy grilled shrimp. Finally, delicate Red Snapper is coated in aromatic Dukkah and served with a fresh Tomato and Chickpea Salad!

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Seeds, Bark + Flower Parts
programme.desc: In this tasty episode of Spice Secrets, Jasmin and Shahir are back to spicing things up with everything from seed to bark to flower part! First up? A yummy French classic, the Croque Madame, gets a new twist with an aromatic Cinnamon Bechamel. Next, Potato Gnocchi gets some pep from poppy seeds, served in rich creamy sauce that's infused with aureate strands of sultry saffron. For a sweet finish, dessert finds an unusual friend in dill seed! A surprise pairing that works well thanks to science!

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join engaging host, Bianca Osbourne, for a taste of two countries. First stop? Italy! Check out her recipe for succulent wild boar ribs, braised until tender, rolled in gremolata, and served over silky polenta. Next up? A culinary tribute to China, pairing lobster claw with chili oil, pomelo foam, and oyster sauce glazed bok choy. Every episode features a 'common ingredient', this time? It's noodles! Drool over two recipes: Italian classic Olio e Aglio next to chewy Chinese long Noodles tossed with Sichuan Chili Oil. For the big finale, Bianca blends Italian style with Chinese flavour for a one-of-a-kind CombiNation Plate: Kung Pao Pork Osso Bucco over Forbidden Black Rice Risotto... made with shiitake mushrooms and bright green edamame peas.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Turkey, think Silk Road spices. Indonesia, lots of seafood and tropical fruits! Curious and adventurous host Bianca Osbourne is your CombiNATION Plates culinary guide through both food cultures. First, check out Turkish Spice Crusted Lamb Rack with yogurt and blistered peppers. Next, an Indonesian tribute: Crab Leg with Coconut Curry. For the 'common ingredient'? Two takes on tender, savoury eggplant! Turkish Eggplant is braised and served with parsley and feta and the Indonesian take is served with fried garlic and sweet soy. For the CombiNATION Plate? Peanut- chili Sate sauce replaces walnut for Pazili TrancÌ§a, a classically Turkish halibut presentation, also served here with unique, savoury, coconut 'baklava' for a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.title: Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a cajun-themed menu with a table to match! There's chili-garlic-cilantro shrimp, fajita rice, cornbread, tomato salad, and so much more!

programme.title: Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a winter-themed menu with a table to match! There's cheddar biscuits, a detox kale salad, roast beef au jus, root vegetable mash, and so much more!

programme.title: Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a vegetable-forward menu with a table to match! There's lentils and mushrooms, watermelon salad, a farro and squash wellington, Eton mess, and so much more!

programme.title: Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a Mediterranean mezze-themed menu with a table to match! There's kofta, hummus, tabbouleh, fattoush, muhammara, and so much more!

programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 France, Japan, Morocco, Mexico
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by France - French Fennel Soup, Japan - Unagi-Style Soy Glazed Figs, Morocco - Moroccan Butterbean Tagine, and Mexico - Asparagus Ceviche!

programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Thailand, France, Sweden, Italy
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Thailand - Carrot Pad Thai, France - Ground Cherry Salad, Sweden - Swedish Pecan Balls, and Italy - Corn Farroto!

programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Vietnam, Lebanon, China, Germany
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Vietnam - Vietnamese Green Beans, Lebanon - Watermelon Tabbouleh, China - Signapore-Style Spaghetti Squash Noodles, and Germany - Celeriac Sauerbraten and Slaw!

programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Italy, Morocco, Ethiopia, Jamaica
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Italy - Roasted Radishes and Radish Pesto, Morocco - Moroccan Spiced Apples, Ethiopia - Ethiopian Spinach Dip, and Jamaica - Jerk Shiitakes with Coconut Rice!

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join Bianca Osbourne to taste and combine! Fun CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne starts this episode with an inspired tribute to Georgian cuisine; Beef Tartare with Tkemali (sour plum sauce), marigold powder, and tart, crunchy pickles. Next; feast your eyes on her unique Hong Kong dumpling: plump scallops, pork, and veggies are blended, rolled, steamed, sliced, and then served with Crispy Yu Choy and XO. The common ingredient is rabbit! Georgia offers up Rabbit 'Mtsvadi', grilled and glazed with pomegranate reduction. Hong Kong represents with Sweet and Sour Rabbit, Grilled Pineapple and Red Pepper Coulis. Finally, Georgian Milk Braised meets Chinese/Hong Kong-style Roast Duck with quail egg and cheese stuffed 'Khachapuri Dumpling' and crunchy 'Peking Duck Crumble', and it's a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne is always looking for the best food in the world to share. The first stop is South Korea with her Sesame Crusted Tuna 'Yukhoe', a delicious blend of favourite Korean flavours. Next stamp on the passport? Spain! Mouth-watering Duck Breast is seared and served rare with a crispy artichoke heart, membrillo, olives, and sweet-savoury sherry reduction. Beef short ribs are the common ingredient with Catalonian Braised and Romesco to one side and sticky Korean Kalbi-style grilled to the east! For the topper, drool over Bulgogi Octopus simmered and served with saffron-scented Sticky Rice Paella cakes, finished with crispy Paprika-Gochujang battered mussel. Yep, it tastes as good as it sounds!

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Travel the world without ever leaving the kitchen! Intrepid host of CombiNATION Plates, Bianca Osbourne, starts this episode with Ethiopian inspired Berbere Spiced Quail, seared in aromatic Niter Kibbeh, and served with crunchy-sour Gomen Salad. Brazil is next, check out this re- invention of Feijoada... with braised and seared pork belly, oranges, crema, and fresh black bean salsa. Common ingredient 'Coffee and Sweets' is next... with java-spiked Injera Crepe Cake for Ethiopia and Brazil blending up a dark roast of rich, coffee-spiked, chocolatey Brigadeiros truffles. The final plate is Coconut Crusted Black Cod with cheesy Brazilian-style Pao de Queijo bites, and teff flour a brush of spiced ghee inspired by Ethiopia.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne for a trip to Morocco and Thailand! First up, whole Red Snapper is rubbed with earthy Ras el Hanout spice, poached in argan oil, and served with char-grilled oranges. Thailand inspires the next plate; Chicken Thigh 'Lollipop', roasted and served with bamboo shoots, chilies, and sauced with peanut-coconut red curry. Next, these countries both love Spring Rolls... Morocco's version, Briouat, is stuffed with saffron couscous and fresh cheese and fried... from Thailand comes a salad roll with shrimp and mango, dipped in a fiery green Nam Jim. Stick around for the big dish - Saffron buttERS-basted beef Striploin, served with complex Apricot-Green Curry Chutney and sent spinning with never before seen Chermoula Grass Jelly!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on bitter sauces! First up, a duo of chimichurris - one with black garlic! Next, a stout and espresso gravy for lamb and a traditional Georgian walnut sauce!

programme.title: The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on fatty sauces! First up, patatas bravas with aioli and brava sauce! Next, classic sauce choron on crab cakes and a duck fat-blood orange emulsion with duck confit!

programme.title: The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on creamy sauces! First a duo of creamy butter sauces with salmon! Next up a sauce créme with beef tenderloin and a vegan coconut créme anglaise!

programme.title: The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on savoury sauces! First up, a soy-miso-honey sauce for seared duck breast! Next, a black demi-glace for hanger steak and a sauce duxelles for scallops!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E13 Italian dishes that will impress any dinner guest
programme.desc: From a trendy meatball appetizer to creamy pasta with chickpeas, decadent stuffed mussels, and succulent salmon with lavender and honey, Chef Vanessa Gianfrancesco wows again with her Italian cuisine.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on spicy sauces! First up, a Cajun comeback sauce for soft-shelled crab! Next, a classic steakhouse mustard sauce and a ginger caramel sauce for ginger caramel apples!

programme.title: The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on wine sauces! First up, a classic veal marsala! Next, a white wine chicken gravy and a port sabayon with grapes!

programme.title: The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on sour sauces! First a brown butter picatta sauce for chicken picatta! Next, a smoked tomato ponzu sauce for fried oysters and a duo of orange marmalade and lemon curd for crepes!

programme.title: The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on veggie sauces! First up, a Provencal sauce tomate to go with halibut! Next, a rustic pepperonata with flank steak and a trio of pestos!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E14 DIY Italian Fine Dining
programme.desc: Italian chef and foodie Vanessa Gianfrancesco shows us how to make dishes delicious enough for a fine restaurant with fried zucchini blossoms, spaghetti carbonara, roast lamb, and fruit crostata.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E17 Japanese food inspired by other cultures
programme.desc: Chef and culinary instructor Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen shows us Japanese cuisine inspired by other cultures with a pork and tofu dish, sesame chicken salad, breaded pork cutlet, and even a French crepe.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Endearing host Pailin Chongchinant makes three popular Thai dishes: Coconut Chicken Soup, Green Papaya Salad, and the most famous, Pad Thai.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne for a trip to Morocco and Thailand! First up, whole Red Snapper is rubbed with earthy Ras el Hanout spice, poached in argan oil, and served with char-grilled oranges. Thailand inspires the next plate; Chicken Thigh 'Lollipop', roasted and served with bamboo shoots, chilies, and sauced with peanut-coconut red curry. Next, these countries both love Spring Rolls... Morocco's version, Briouat, is stuffed with saffron couscous and fresh cheese and fried... from Thailand comes a salad roll with shrimp and mango, dipped in a fiery green Nam Jim. Stick around for the big dish - Saffron buttERS-basted beef Striploin, served with complex Apricot-Green Curry Chutney and sent spinning with never before seen Chermoula Grass Jelly!
